name: Panadol Extra
indications: Relief of mild to moderate pain (headache, toothache, backache, joint pain) and fever.
dosageSimpleEn: Take 1 or 2 tablets every 4 to 6 hours as needed. Do not exceed 8 tablets in 24 hours.
dosageSimpleRw: Fata ibinini 1 cyangwa 2 buri masaha 4 kugeza kuri 6 igihe cyose ubibabara. Ntukarenze ibinini 8 mu masaha 24.
warningEn: Contains paracetamol. Do not take with other paracetamol-containing products. Avoid excessive alcohol usage.
warningRw: Harimo paracetamol. Ntukayifatane n'indi miti irimo paracetamol. Irinde kunywa inzoga nyinshi mu gihe uyifata.

name: Amoxicillin Capsule
indications: Treatment of bacterial infections such as ear, nose, throat, skin, and urinary tract infections.
dosageSimpleEn: Take 1 capsule 3 times a day (every 8 hours) with or without food for 5 to 7 days. Complete the full course.
dosageSimpleRw: Fata agasanduku 1 inshuro 3 ku munsi (buri masaha 8) hamwe n'ibiryo cyangwa utabirye, mu gihe cy'iminsi 5 kugeza kuri 7. Genda ubirangize byose ubashe gukira neza.
warningEn: Finish the entire prescription even if you feel better. Do not take if you have a known penicillin allergy.
warningRw: Nuzamara kumva utangiye gukira, ntugahagarike gufata umuti kugeza uwo waguhaye ushize. Ntukawufate niba ufite ubwivumbure bwa penicillin.

name: Coartem
indications: Treatment of acute, uncomplicated malaria infections caused by Plasmodium falciparum.
dosageSimpleEn: Take 4 tablets twice daily (morning and evening) with fatty food or milk for exactly 3 days (total 24 tablets).
dosageSimpleRw: Fata ibinini 4 inshuro 2 ku munsi (mu gitondo na nimugoroba) uherekeje ibiryo bifite ibinure cyangwa amata, mu gihe cy'iminsi 3 neza.
warningEn: Always complete the entire 3-day treatment. Take with food to ensure maximum absorption and effectiveness.
warningRw: Buri gihe wuzure iminsi 3 yose yo kwivuza nubwo waba ukira. Fata umuti uherekejwe n'amafunguro kugira ngo ubashe gukora neza.

name: Ibuprofen
indications: Relief of rheumatoid arthritis, osteoarthritis, dental pain, and muscular pain.
dosageSimpleEn: Take 1 tablet twice a day after meals. Do not take on an empty stomach.
dosageSimpleRw: Fata ikinini 1 inshuro 2 ku munsi nyuma yo kurya. Ntukawufate ushonje (nta kintu kiri mu nda).
warningEn: Always take after meals to prevent stomach irritation. Consult a doctor if you have stomach ulcers.
warningRw: Buri gihe fata umuti umaze kurya kugira ngo wirinde kubabara mu nda. Baza muganga niba ufite ibisebe mu nda (ulcers).
